name: emc-helpline-backend-tooling
description: Emulators and tests for the EMC Helpline backend. The app itself is Flutter — see README.md.

scripts.backend: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test:emulator && npm run test:workflow
scripts.test:workflow: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-emc "vitest run functions/test/workflow.test.ts"
scripts.console: npm run console:config && npm run console:agent
